filter_rules.per_generator: entire diagnostic real pool plus fake rows of one generator
filter_rules.source_macro: unweighted mean of source fullset EER; undefined domains explicitly excluded

replication: seed42 fixed before diagnostics; never choose best seed

resource_profile.scope: 16 registered train videos, resource profile only; larger microbatches repeat these inputs; no dev/diagnostic/holdout scoring or model selection; timing under concurrent CLIP16 extraction is not standalone throughput

scope.adapted_features: FP32 prefix tokens; BF16 AMP suffix/head training; backbone eval disables stochastic depth in both adaptation and control
scope.diagnostic_timing: cached features/tokens; excludes decoding and is not full CLI throughput
scope.frontend: 16 frames, 224 native_center_crop; Swin ImageNet norm and CLIP own norm; current controlled input short side 256, no claim of arbitrary-input official-transform equivalence
scope.frozen_features: FP32 full-encoder features; Swin [1,768] spacetime pooled, CLIP [16,768] per-frame mean-head aggregation
scope.historical_four_frame: description only; previous training budgets differ (C17 108280 vs current 108240 draws); no historical retraining
scope.inference_failures: included in denominator; fullset EER undefined if any failures
scope.nonfinite_scores: rejected by existing score contract; never dropped
scope.pretrained_backbones: Swin3D-T KINETICS400_V1 vs CLIP ViT-L/14; architecture, capacity and pretraining differ; not a pure temporal causal comparison

source_mapping.evidence: independent read-only review of retained package digest plus exact-path git -c safe.directory lookup; no global Git configuration changed
source_mapping.limitation: retained-source mapping does not rewrite the contemporaneous unavailable commit record
source_mapping.scope: posthoc mapping of retained feature-producer source; original preparation records unchanged

standard_smoke.scope: standard raw OfflineScorer path and FP32 cached-score agreement only; not a generalization estimate

temporal_probe.scope: descriptive already-used dev; repetition changes appearance coverage; no pure-motion causal or blind-generalization claim

provenance.epoch_selection: expanded dev source macro EER only

features.cache_reused_by: media SHA256; original row identities retained

provenance.initialization: fresh seed-specific random head; no old head loaded
